name: automation-restaurant
description: Automation Restaurant — multi-tenant SaaS POS with tier-gated feature provisioning.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @automation-restaurant/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @automation-restaurant/web -- -p 3001
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @automation-restaurant/api && npm run typecheck -w @automation-restaurant/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @automation-restaurant/api && npm run build -w @automation-restaurant/web
